name: Soothing Spices
label: Quest
description: "Swamp Eye" Jarl loves cooking, swamp style, and needs soothing spice for a stew. Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh asks you to bring three Soothing Spices.
intro: "Swamp Eye" Jarl loves cooking, swamp style, and needs soothing spice for a stew. Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh asks you to bring three Soothing Spices.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: I like cooking. Good swamp cooking. Fried green frog legs and the like.
And for cooking, I need spice. Soothing spice. Then I'll make a stew and stew it up and suck it down and give you some too.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Spice. We could all use some spice in our life. You agree?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, that's the spice! Now here's some swampy good stew.
